system_prompt_style.note: Main agent prompt file (scrl/llm_agent/generation.py) not in bundle; reading agent uses EXTRACT_NEW_INFO_PROMPT.format templates.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: DeepResearcher invokes the web search tool by generating a JSON-formatted request with the tool name web search and the search queries as arguments.
env_context_strategy.note: Web environment, not repo; agent navigates via search/browse tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: it compiles all newly added information from the short-term memory and returns it to the DeepResearcher system.
context_compaction.note: Reading agent condenses webpages into extracted info (scrl/handler/reading_agent/reading_agent.py). History-level compaction not visible.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Search results are returned in a structured format
observation_format.note: Browse results returned as extracted text summaries.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: In the actual model, the tool call and tool response format is a JSON string, rather than a tag.

tool_count.evidence_quote: The search and browse are 2 apis in json format in the real inference stage.
tool_count.note: Answer given via <answer> tag, not a tool.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The search and browse are 2 apis in json format in the real inference stage.
edit_primitive.note: Only search and browse tools; no file editing.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool schema definition file not in bundle.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency files/grep results in bundle.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: it conducts reasoning and tool selection based on the user question and observations iteratively
loop_primitives.note: Reading agent loops page_down per page (reading_agent.py).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: planning abilities can emerge naturally without the necessity of SFT on explicit planning data

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We employ a multi-agent framework wherein a dedicated reading agent is tasked with extracting pertinent information from crawled webpages.
multi_agent_topology.note: Main policy delegates browsing to ReadingAgent (qwen-plus).

delegation_mechanism.note: Reading agent invoked per URL with fresh message list; closest value.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the agent maintains a short-term memory repository for each query
short_term_state.note: Reading agent memory; main agent conversation-only likely.

long_term_memory.note: Search cache exists but is not agent memory; memory config not in bundle.

self_verification.note: LLM judge used only for evaluation (MBE), not in-loop.

retry_policy.note: Paper retry mechanism concerns API/crawl transport, not task retries.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Each rollout consists of up to 10 tool calls followed by a final answer step.

timeouts.note: HTTP request timeout for page fetch.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we created a distributed CPU server cluster with 50 nodes, specifically designed to manage the Tool requests
execution_isolation.note: Tools are web requests via server handlers; no code execution.

network_policy.evidence_quote: DeepResearcher does not restrict the search space to a specific domain, such as Wikipedia

tracing.evidence_quote: You can find the rollout file in: ```./outputs/{project_name}/{experiment_name}/rollout/rollout_step_0.json```

target_domain.evidence_quote: end-to-end training of LLM-based deep research agents through scaling reinforcement learning (RL) in real-world environments with authentic web search interactions

open_source.note: LICENSE file listed but contents not in bundle; verl parts Apache-2.0.

model_agnostic.note: Trained Qwen2.5-7B policy; reading agent uses OpenAI-compatible client (qwen-plus). Closest value.
